scientific_integrity: Independent audit not performed; theorem has complete integer-presentation proof and reproducible finite Smith-form checks. No claim of independent certification.
scientific_limitations: Only \(n\ge3\) and \(1\le t\le n-1\), equal sides and pairwise-disjoint deleted edges. Does not classify \(t=0\), \(t=n\), asymmetric bipartitions or arbitrary deletions. Novelty search is not exhaustive; independent audit not performed.
title: Critical groups of partial matching deletions from balanced complete bipartite graphs
